# Presentation Remote v1.1.3

## 修正内容 / Fixes

- Reorganize bilingual Help into a five-step QR connection guide, simpler presentation controls and optional technical/troubleshooting details; remove dismissal instructions.

- Align the desktop footer's left edge with the header content; mobile footer remains hidden.
- Keep the intended 0.6° motion-pointer dead zone and 13 px speaker-note size for first-time visitors.
- Ignore missing orientation sensor values rather than accepting them as zeros.
- Cancel QR scanning reliably when the camera prompt is pending or a different camera is selected.
- Resize PDF presentations to fit the browser window without recreating the deck.
- Restore the previous slide when rendering the selected slide fails, with visible feedback.
- Add automated regression coverage for all of the above.
- Automatically create a matching versioned tag, standalone HTMLs, ZIP archive and SHA-256 checksum file after a version-bumped PR is merged.

## 配布ファイル / Assets

- `htmlapps-presentation-remote-v1.1.3.html` — Standalone HTML
- `htmlapps-presentation-remote-v1.1.3.self-extract.html` — Self-extracting HTML
- `htmlapps-presentation-remote-v1.1.3.zip` — Docs, manifests, license and builds
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` — SHA-256 checksums
